_note: Ordered by information, not convenience. If the queue does not finish, what ran is what mattered most. Every arm runs on suite 0.4.0 so the table is comparable on one version.
_backends: Both models now run on Ollama, so no backend dance is needed. Nemotron uses the `nemotron-gpu` Modelfile (modelfiles/Modelfile.nemotron-gpu), which forces num_gpu 99: Ollama's automatic placement left 15% of its layers on CPU at 12.7 tok/s, and forcing full residency gives 48.9 tok/s at 100% VRAM -- past llama.cpp's 42.65 on the same file. llama-server is retired from this queue: it runs under WSL, whose 4.3 GiB cap cannot hold a 6.7 GB model, and it was killed mid-sweep on 2026-09-15 and again on 2026-09-17.
_grouping: Nemotron jobs first, then qwen, so Ollama swaps models once rather than per job. A swap costs a full load.
_reruns_2026-09-18: Every nemotron arm is a rerun from zero: the 2026-09-15 llama-server sweep is void, and the single monolith row from 2026-09-17 was produced on llama.cpp and discarded so that every model-call row in results_nemotron comes from one backend. baseline is kept -- it makes no model call, and it was verified identical to the qwen baseline across all 34 tasks. The qwen jobs are coverage top-ups, not reruns: those arms were recorded before the suite gained its last two tasks.
